name: BreakEngagement
description: Call off your engagement to the player. Only when you clearly end it now; not for past breakups, doubts or someone else's engagement.
note: Needs M.A.R.A.S, Mantella Living World - Relationships and Mantella's Advanced Actions. Asks the player Yes/No first, once per game day per NPC; choosing No blocks a retry that day.
prompt: If you clearly call off your engagement to the player, begin your response with '{key}:'
